name: apple-video-kit

scripts.dev: npm run -s media && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.120 preview
scripts.check: npm run -s media && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.120 check
scripts.render: npm run -s media && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.120 render
scripts.share:dev: node scripts/sync-share.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.120 preview projects/screen-share
scripts.share:check: node scripts/sync-share.mjs && node scripts/check-face-clear.mjs projects/screen-share/index.html && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.120 check projects/screen-share
scripts.share:render: node scripts/sync-share.mjs && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.120 render projects/screen-share

description: Apple-style motion templates, transitions and a screen-share stage for HyperFrames videos.
